
# ESP-NOW MQTT Gateway Peer Library

> Documentation for the header-only ESP32 Peer Library used to communicate with an ESP-NOW MQTT Gateway.

The Peer Library runs on ESP32 leaf devices. It provides encrypted ESP-NOW messaging, queued delivery, message builders, callbacks, and time synchronization with a gateway. The gateway translates messages between ESP-NOW and MQTT.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/intro.md): Overview, capabilities, requirements, and message flow.
- [Installation](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/installation.md): Arduino and PlatformIO setup, dependencies, and size-limit overrides.
- [Quick Start](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/quick-start.md): Keys, addresses, a minimal peer sketch, and initialization.
- [Architecture](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/architecture.md): Peer/gateway topology, security, and message flow.
- [Configuration Reference](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/configuration.md): Constants, payload sizing, and build synchronization.
- [Message Types and Wire Format](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/message-types.md): Message types, payload structures, and the message envelope.
- [Peer Class](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/peer.md): Configuration, initialization, builders, callbacks, and dispatch.
- [Utilities](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/utils.md): Time, key, MAC, and conversion helpers.
- [Message Queue and Delivery](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/message-queue.md): Queueing, retries, delivery limitations, and backpressure.
- [Time Synchronization](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/time-sync.md): Sync requests, clock updates, and usage.
- [Security and Encryption](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/security.md): PMK, LMK, encrypted traffic, and key management.
- [Examples](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/examples.md): Sensor sketches, Wake-on-LAN, metrics, and notifications.
- [Troubleshooting](https://devlotfi.github.io/esp-now-mqtt-gateway/troubleshooting.md): Common setup, messaging, and time-sync issues.
